text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
(Orfe-san... Such magnificent power, and 
such an overwhelming presence...! If I let 
my guard down for even a second, I'll be 
swept away.)

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: —In that case! I'll push... ahead of you!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: The strongest—is ME!! HAAAAAAAAAAAH!!
(Oooooohhhh...!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
It wasn't a fluke...! Gentildonna has... 
surpassed Orfevre! S-So strong!!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
To think that I, the King, have once 
again...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Gentildonna...—

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Fans
text_block_list.text:
Lady Orfeeeeevvvre!! Even so, you're still 
the strongest...!

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Fans
text_block_list.text:
Next time, victory will surely crown your 
head! I will follow you anywhere...!!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
âBehold, Gentile. My stronghold has yet 
to crumble.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
It certainly seems so. It appears they 
have built it quite solidly.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"I shall not be crushed. Not even by the 
likes of your strength."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
I will be heading to France again this 
year. Therefore, it cannot be done right 
away, but...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: I shall surely bring you down.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"Until then, you had best pile up as many 
crowns as you can to offer me."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Have a safe journey. If you happen to 
return as a hero—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I shall break that pride of yours and 
remind you of this day.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Surely, it's already...—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: I have claimed victory without issue.

Gentildonna returned. She was as dignified 
as ever, but... I noticed the slightest, 
tiniest sense of unease.
choice_data_list:
(Do her movements seem a little more 
relaxed?)

text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it, right after the 
race... she seemed unable to hide her 
exhaustion. Under normal circumstances, 
that would never happen with her."
choice_data_list: (So it was that fierce a battle...)

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ...What is it?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
...Trying to pry into someone's secrets is 
hardly gentlemanly.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
...Trying to pry into someone's secrets is 
utterly unrefined.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: "Indeed, my legs feel heavier than usual."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Yet here I stand. With head held high, as 
the victor.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Do I appear in your eyes as someone so 
fragile they might collapse?

Even as she speaks, sweat trickles down 
her cheek. Her breathing is shallow... 
Yet, standing proud, she—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: I imagine so.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"She forced her way past Orfe-san twice... 
That was no easy feat."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I won... and stood in the winner's 
circle. That is all that matters.”

Right then, from the other side... I could 
see Verxina pulling back. Gentildonna 
seemed to have spotted her as well—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if it's partly due to the 
influence of you... and that person.
choice_data_list: By "that person"... do you mean Verxina?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: “‘Pride’... The weapon you spoke of.”

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
—It reminded me of Verxina. The one who 
relentlessly chased after me all through 
last year.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Her stubborn pride, her sheer refusal to 
lose to me...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
She was a threat you couldn't help but be 
conscious of... without a doubt.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
So you learned, didn't you? That stubborn 
step forward...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
—From the sheer strength of that person 
who kept pushing me to the brink.

Whether she heard it or not... Verxina 
walked away without looking back even 
once.

Her spine straightened—held with quiet 
poise.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ...Heh.
choice_data_list:
You let me hear that on purpose, didn't 
you?
You meant for me to hear that, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ...She has a role to play.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
To continuously prove the worth of my 
Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
The more results she achieves, the more my 
own strength shines.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
It wouldn't do to have them step down 
here, after all.
choice_data_list: No need to worry about that.

text_block_list.text:
Before the race, the look in Verxina's 
eyes as she gazed at Gentildonna— 
undeniably held a "fire" within them.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Uuu... I wonder if Big Sis is okay.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: She had no energy at all, didn't she...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if she's starting to feel like 
she doesn't want to run anymore...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Ah! She's here! Onee-chan—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: You two! We're going home!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Huh!? U-Um... Big sis—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Analyze the reasons for the loss, adjust 
the training menu... There's so much to 
do!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
This time for sure... I'm going to beat 
her!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...! Big Sis, you're sparkling...!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Then, then, let's all hold hands on the 
way home♡
(Grip...!)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
W-Wait... Th-This is embarrassing...! 
Waaaaah...!

—Upon returning to the academy... there 
was a lone Umamusume standing in front of 
the school gate. She had a serious look on 
her face...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Yo, Gentile. ...I've been waitin' for ya.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Here, take this. It's a token of my 
feelings.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer. Please accept this in my 
stead.

I reverently accept the bouquet from Gold 
Ship— and in that moment, I feel a gentle 
warmth and catch a faint scent of powder.

I hurriedly took a closer look, and what 
lay deep inside the bouquet was—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Soft noodles, extra green onion and ponzu, 
with a salty rush. Dig in.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Gentil. Heard you went and blew away that 
tyrant not once, but twice, huh?"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
And you're takin' Golshi-chan's tuna with 
ya too...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: —Heh, sounds fun.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"I loooove that kind of thing! You're more 
than welcome to it!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Doors no one can bust down, rugged 
roads... unreachable skyscrapers! They're 
all mine!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Racing is a treasure island! Overflowing 
with excitement and—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Fireworks that burn you to ashes. With 
you, I feel like we could really set them 
off."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Hohoho. So you are next after Orfe, are 
you?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
A fellow Classic Double Crown Umamusume of 
the same generation... Indeed, quite the 
timely opponent, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Very well. I accept.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: *Flop flop floooop!!*

Her composure remains completely unbroken, 
even in the face of Gold Ship's intense 
personality... That too is part of 
Gentildonna's strength.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
So yeah, buddy. Go ahead and register 
Golshi-chan and Gentil.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: "Takarazuka Kinen! Nice to meetcha."

And so, the next target race was set... It 
seems we're heading for the Takarazuka 
Kinen, the Grand Prix that caps off the 
first half of the year!
